title: Full list queries, PATCH and slug redirects from ctx.backend
why: Server load() and server functions reach the same filters, sort, cursor pages, PATCH and slug history as the HTTP API without a second database client.
changelog: `ctx.backend` speaks the full HTTP list contract from server code

adopt.snippet: const page = await ctx.backend.resource('products').list({ filter: { category: 'tools' }, sort: ['price'], limit: 24 })
